ops.title: Recovery refix2 review: residual groupless host binding defect
ops.body:
ISSUES: 1 — FAIL at 1a6b2c74f318d686489c24920097853afe2a344a.

Target: /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/orca/xmr-refix2, branch cc-sync/xmr-refix2.
Reviewed against 07b53148d9ed5ad1936392780e64ac22287fec33.
Original report: /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/cc-sync/reviews/orca-refix-refute.txt.

major — A groupless host layout still strands dormant recovery bindings, with or without a groupless client view.

Evidence: src/main/runtime/cross-machine-recovery/recovery-host-binding-tabs.ts:16-17 and :89-91; /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/layout-scratch-final.log:8-9.
The real exporter accepts a host session containing terminal rows and resumable records but no unified tabs and groups. Import returns success and marks the bindings dormant; renderer reconciliation removes all imported terminal rows and layouts while retaining the import marker and sleeping records, leaving no Resume tabs.

Reproduction:
1. Call Store.persistPtyBinding with hostAdmittedMembership:true to create three source terminal rows and stable leaf layouts. Add three resumable sleeping records and flush through the real SQLite authority, leaving unified tabs and groups absent.
2. Flush successfully, verify independent SQLite readback, and call buildRecoveryDescriptor on Store.getWorkspaceSession('local'). It exports three terminal rows and three bindings with empty layout.tabs and layout.groups. The descriptor passes OrcaRecoveryDescriptorV1Schema.
3. Run planRecoveryImport, handleCrossMachineRecoveryApplyRequest, then reconcileWorktreeTabModel. The import acknowledges success; the final tabsByWorktree destination is [], terminalLayoutsByTabId is {}, and three dormant records plus the import marker survive.
4. Repeat with a preferred groupless client view produced by projectPresentationView. The same failure occurs.

This input is production-reachable, not only schema-valid: applyPtyBinding creates a minimal terminal row and leaf layout without unified placement (src/main/persistence/loading-store/pty-binding-session-update.ts:63-84 and :132-142); runtime spawn enables that membership path (src/main/ipc/pty/runtime/spawn-commit.ts:136). Store loading merges parsed data with defaults without synthesizing placement (src/main/persistence/loading-store/normalize-loaded-state-collections.ts:25-38); unified tabs and groups remain optional (src/shared/workspace-session-schema.ts:266-276). Export reads Store state directly (src/main/runtime/cross-machine-recovery/recovery-export.ts:212), and projectRecoveryLayout independently defaults missing tabs/groups to [] (src/main/runtime/cross-machine-recovery/recovery-layout-projection.ts:74-84). A second reviewer independently checked this producer chain and could not refute it.

Concrete fix: normalize bound terminal placement even when the chosen view is the host itself, and synthesize a unified terminal tab and valid group/order from the bound terminal row when neither layout contains a unified tab. Removing only the view===host shortcut is insufficient because withPlacedTerminalTab also returns when host.tabs has no entry.

This residual variant predates the reviewed fixes. The base already has the same host-only early return and assumes a host unified row (git show 07b53148d9ed5ad1936392780e64ac22287fec33:src/main/runtime/cross-machine-recovery/recovery-import-plan.ts, lines 85-86 and 113). It is not a newly introduced regression. It prevents a PASS under the requested adversarial layout coverage.

Evidence artifacts:
- /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/host-only-groupless-descriptor.json
- /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/host-and-client-groupless-descriptor.json
- /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/host-groupless-after.json
- /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/layout-scratch-final.log

Verification:
All commands below ran in the target checkout with prefix:
ORCA_BACKGROUND_LAUNCH=1 mise exec node@24.21.0 pnpm@12.0.0 --

1. pnpm tc — exit 0 before scratch tests and after scratch cleanup; /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/typecheck.log and /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/typecheck-final.log.
2. pnpm exec vitest run --config config/vitest.config.ts cross-machine-recovery src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/pty-connection-dormant-recovery-gate.test.ts src/renderer/src/components/terminal-pane/pty-connection-recovery-binding-dormancy.test.ts src/renderer/src/lib/resume-sleeping-agent-session-recovery-origin.test.ts — 32 files, 194 tests passed; /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/recovery-suite.log.
3. Renderer rollback lane — 32 passed: 16 existing apply tests plus 16 scratch variants; /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/rollback-final.log and rollback.txt.
4. SQLite durability lane — 12 passed: 4 existing durable regressions plus 8 scratch schedules; /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/durable-vitest.log and durable.txt.
5. Layout and routing scratch — 10 passed, 2 failed across 2 files; /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/layout-scratch-final.log and layout.txt. Both failures are the one finding above.
6. Original projected-layout, dormancy, and routing checks — 55 passed across 9 files; /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/layout-safety.log and layout.txt.

Original repro A passes: later user-created terminal, dirty open-file row, and draft survive failed initial import. Original repro B passes over the real SQLite queue: a retry waits for rollback and persists a fresh import. The original retained-terminal client-view layout repro passes when the host supplies unified placement. These are committed tests at cross-machine-recovery-apply.test.ts:286, cross-machine-recovery-durable-apply.unit.test.ts:136, and cross-machine-recovery-projected-view-import.unit.test.ts:35 in src/renderer/src/store/slices, tests/e2e, and tests/e2e respectively.

Additional passing variants:
- User edits to imported terminal titles, labels, colors, pin state, pane layout, and group placement.
- Imported files with drafts, dirty flags, or only a disk baseline; repeated reconciliation without user edits.
- Three overlapping requests to one destination or different destinations; second-write failures for coalesced imports and claims.
- Sibling writes during rollback correction; failed correction followed by successful writes; replay and retry after fresh-renderer hydration from SQLite.
- Multiple bindings and split panes across mixed client views; dormant connection gates; selected SSH environment without remote recovery routing.
Detailed commands and limits are in the lane reports.

Reload coverage uses fresh renderer stores hydrated from persisted SQLite state or serialized session payloads. No full Electron restart or visible UI run was performed. No production edits were made.

Cleanup verified: HEAD remains 1a6b2c74f318d686489c24920097853afe2a344a; git status --porcelain=v1 and git diff --stat are empty; git diff --check exits 0; rg --files src tests -g *refute2* finds no scratch sources. Evidence: /tmp/xmr-refix2-review/cleanup.json. All test sources created for this review were deleted; logs and JSON evidence remain in /tmp/xmr-refix2-review.
